coverageRationale.zh: 把 GM/T 0054-2018 从“四层四级的清单”推进到可复述的判定链：层面/等级矩阵、应/宜/可语义、逐项覆盖谓词、整体等级取最大通过级，以及 GB/T 39786 与 GM/T 0115 的分工。
coverageRationale.en: Moves GM/T 0054-2018 from a four-layer/four-level list to a reproducible decision chain: layer/level matrix, shall/should/may semantics, itemwise coverage predicate, maximum passing level and the split between GB/T 39786 and GM/T 0115.

宜：推荐型条款，首选但非强制。

en: Shall: a requirement that must be met for conformity.
Should: a recommendation, preferred but not mandatory.
May: a permission within the standard’s boundary.
Layer: one of the four technical domains physical, network, device and application.

zh.principle: **标准**：GM/T 0054-2018 信息系统密码应用基本要求（GM/T 0054-2018 General Requirements for Information System Cryptography Application）。GM/T 0054-2018 把信息系统密码应用拆成四个技术层面：物理和环境安全、网络和通信安全、设备和计算安全、应用和数据安全。每个层面按等级保护一级至四级分别写要求，并用“应/宜/可”标注强制、推荐与允许。除技术层面外，标准单列密钥管理，并要求安全管理制度、人员、实施、应急。形式化地看，给定系统 S、等级 L、层面 d 和要求项 p，R(L,d,p) 取“应/宜/可”；Pass(S,L) 要求所有“应”项都被 S 满足，Overall(S) 取满足 Pass 的最高等级。
zh.why: 这份 2018 行业标准是密评试点早期的基线：它先回答“不同等级的信息系统应当怎么用密码”，再由 GM/T 0115 回答“怎么测评”。把两者混成一张表，会把“要求”误当“评分”，也会把 2018 版与 2021 国家标准 GB/T 39786 的差异抹掉。应/宜/可的语义也决定了合规判定：一个系统不能靠“宜”项做得好来抵消“应”项缺失；密钥管理和安全管理不是附录，而是与技术层面并列的基线组成。
zh.used: 做差距分析时，先定系统等级 L，再按四个技术层面和密钥管理、制度、人员、实施、应急逐项填 R(L,d,p) 与现状 S(d,p)。只把“应”项列为必须整改；“宜”项作为改进建议；“可”项按场景选用。测评阶段另用 GM/T 0115 的单元、对象和量化规则，不把该条目的 Pass 谓词当评分公式。需要引用国家标准时，用 GB/T 39786-2021，并保留 2018 行业版的版本坐标。
zh.broken: 把 GM/T 0054 当测评标准会误用：它没有 GM/T 0115 的测评单元、证据要求和量化评分。把“宜”项当“应”项会过度合规，把“应”项漏掉则会直接不通过。标准状态本身也有版本风险：全国标准信息公共服务平台记录显示“废止”，检索页与部分销售页仍标“现行”，而官方 2021 说明确认其内容已上升为 GB/T 39786-2021。因此历史引用必须写明“GM/T 0054-2018 行业基线”，不能把它当作当前唯一依据。
zh.history:
GM/T 0054-2018 于 2018-02-08 由原国家密码管理局发布并实施，用于指导密评试点期间的密码应用。2021 年，标准经修改完善上升为 GB/T 39786-2021《信息安全技术 信息系统密码应用基本要求》，于 2021-10-01 实施。与此配套，GM/T 0115-2021 和 GM/T 0116-2021 分别规范信息系统密码应用测评要求与测评过程；GM/T 0054 因此主要作为 2018 行业基线保留在历史与标准对照中。

**技术参数与复算边界**

该条目的形式模型是 \(S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\)。输入：输入：GM/T 0054-2018 信息系统密码应用基本要求的公开参数、密钥/随机数与消息；变量说明：S 为综合安全强度；各分量取最小值，不能只看密钥位数。 预期输出：按 GM/T 0054-2018 信息系统密码应用基本要求 的规范执行后得到可验证的输出或可比较的优势界。 复算必须给出输入、步骤、输出和单位；示例只演示流程，不替代标准测试向量。

复杂度由密钥长度、分组/状态规模、轮数、随机数质量和敌手模型共同决定；参数越界、版本差异与实现侧信道都可能使公式结论失效。已登记限制：该条目只给出形式模型与可复算步骤，不声称已完成生产实现、侧信道认证或第三方安全评估。

\[S=\min_i S_i,\quad S_i\in\{\text{密钥强度},\text{分组安全},\text{实现安全}\}\]

en.principle: **Standard**: GM/T 0054-2018 General Requirements for Information System Cryptography Application (GM/T 0054-2018 信息系统密码应用基本要求). GM/T 0054-2018 splits information-system cryptography into four technical layers: physical/environment, network/communication, device/compute and application/data. Each layer states requirements by protection level 1 to 4 and marks them shall/should/may for mandatory, recommended and permitted. Besides the technical layers, the standard separates key management and requires security policy, people, implementation and response. Formally, given system S, level L, layer d and item p, R(L,d,p) is shall/should/may; Pass(S,L) requires every shall item to hold, and Overall(S) is the highest level that passes.
en.why:
This 2018 industry standard was the early baseline for cryptography assessment pilots: it answers “how should systems at different levels use cryptography”, while GM/T 0115 answers “how to assess it”. Merging the two turns requirements into a score and erases the difference between the 2018 edition and the 2021 national GB/T 39786.

The shall/should/may semantics also decide conformity: a system cannot offset a missing shall item with strong should items; key management and security management are baseline parts, not appendices.
en.used:
For a gap analysis, fix the system level L, then fill R(L,d,p) and current S(d,p) for the four technical layers plus key management, policy, people, implementation and response. Only shall items are mandatory remediation; should items are improvements; may items are context-dependent.

Assessment uses the GM/T 0115 units, objects and quantitative rules; the Pass predicate here is not a scoring formula. When citing the national baseline, use GB/T 39786-2021 and keep the 2018 industry edition as a version coordinate.

A shared name may belong to an algorithm, standard, event, person or term; this entry is responsible only for its catalogue binding and does not absorb adjacent records. If versions, regions or institutions define the name differently, the differences stay side by side.
en.broken:
Treating GM/T 0054 as an assessment standard misuses it: it lacks GM/T 0115’s assessment units, evidence rules and quantitative scoring. Treating should as shall over-complies; missing a shall item fails outright.

The standard’s own status is a version risk: the national standards record shows “abolished”, while the search page and some sales pages still say “current”, and the official 2021 note confirms the content was raised to GB/T 39786-2021. Historical citations must say “GM/T 0054-2018 industry baseline” and must not present it as the only current basis.
en.history:
GM/T 0054-2018 was published and effective on 2018-02-08 by the then NCA, guiding cryptography application during assessment pilots. In 2021 it was refined and raised to GB/T 39786-2021, effective 2021-10-01.

GM/T 0115-2021 and GM/T 0116-2021 then standardized assessment requirements and process; GM/T 0054 therefore remains mainly as the 2018 industry baseline in historical and cross-standard comparisons.
